source_kind: AI-generated original reference/master artwork, with no input reference images; not a tutorial image or commercial-game asset.
processing: Original generated PNG copied unchanged. Pillow used only to read size, alpha statistics and per-cell bounds. No resampling, palette conversion, removal of pixels, image editing or crop exports.
reuse: Offered as repository example artwork under the root MIT license only to the extent rights are held; no assertion of exclusive authorship, uniqueness, hand drawing or independent copyright protection.

layout.intended: Landscape 3:2; full-body merchant in left third; six same-family goods in right two-thirds, two columns by three rows.
layout.observed: Complete full-body woman at left, six distinct goods at right in the requested row-major order, separated by transparent gutters. Character reaches slightly past x=512 (one-third); inspection split uses x=600.

visual_review.method: Actual generated output and saved original viewed; observations refer to this single image.
observed: One complete woman, grey-black bun, cream sleeves, warm brown blouse, dark teal apron, dark lower garments and shoes; she holds a small tied seed pouch.
Six distinct goods are present in two columns and three rows: bok choy packet, radish packet, rice sack, chili packet, blueberry pot, compost sack. The packets use pictorial vegetables without text.
Dark colored outlines, stepped silhouettes and warm paper / teal / brown color families connect the portrait and objects. No UI frame, labels, ground plane or painted shop background is present.

The visible item faces are readable and their lighting broadly agrees with an upper-left light; portrait and bags nonetheless have softer tonal variation and more internal detail than the intended two-to-three-shade material rule.
limits: Character reads as a kindly adult, but a clearly middle-aged identity is not strongly guaranteed by facial features.
The requested common 4x logical grid and native 32x32 item / approximately 96x176 portrait construction were not achieved or verified. Actual source subject bounds are recorded in atlas.json.
Goods are not exactly equal silhouette sizes: the compost sack is wider and the seedling is taller; fit proportionally into the intended logical boxes.
Real transparent gaps are present, but faint low-alpha tails extend into gutters and the output has soft-edge/halo appearance. Hard alpha fails: max alpha 254, no pixels at 255.
Exact RGB palette membership and per-material two-to-three-shade counts have not passed; visual color-family resemblance must not be reported as quantized palette conformance.
The rice icon includes a few small loose grains belonging to the icon; the image should not be described as a perfectly minimal native sprite sheet.

production_status: NOT_CERTIFIED: suitable for original style/composition reference; hard-alpha failure and unresolved native-grid/palette requirements remain.
follow_up_boundary: No second generation or automatic image cleanup performed. Later backgrounds/panels may use this original as a visual reference; do not silently treat the source as already production-ready.
